title: Importer --allow-dupes Flag
description: Adds --allow-dupes flag to importer.py for force-importing legitimate duplicate transactions (same day, same amount, same merchant). Uses row-index hash in allow-dupes mode so each CSV row gets a unique hash. Normal imports unchanged.
author: Ka'tuar'el + Claude
changes: Added make_hash_with_index() — includes row_index in hash for allow-dupes mode
USAAParser accepts allow_dupes parameter, switches hash function accordingly
main() accepts --allow-dupes CLI flag, passes to USAAParser
